messages.author: 39c75c3232f4685d
messages.subject: Variogram.fit cog not plotting
parts:
Hi 

I'm having an issue with some of my animals variograms, when running variogram.fit, the cog does not plot on the plot, even when I specify interactive=TRUE. I then can't adjust the model and save the ouput. For some animals it plots properly, or others it won't. What could be causing this? Is there a workaround?

messages.author: 03ed0e6cae6a439a
messages.subject: Re: Variogram.fit cog not plotting
parts:
Hi Christie,
I am sure someone may have a better workaround, but when it didn't work for me, I found that if I loaded the below code first, the cog would appear after running interactive = TRUE:

# Run if cog is not showing in top left
library(manipulate)
manipulate(plot(1:x), x = slider(5, 10))

Hope it helps!
Mark

messages.subject: Re: Variogram.fit cog not plotting
parts:
Hi Christie,

The manipulate package in RStudio that variogram.fit() uses is a little buggy (or maybe RStudio itself) and sometimes it requires being run a few times first like Mark has replied with a suggestion for doing.
At some point I need to export the ctmmweb RShiny version as another option.

Best,
Chris
